findings.evidence: `nl -ba ...NormalizerQuotientFiberAction.lean` shows line 196 has `theorem regularNormalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsPretransitiveOfNormal` and line 197 has `(hreg : IsRegular p)`; the naming reference says theorem names describe the conclusion and use `of` to separate hypotheses.
findings.fix: Rename it to put the conclusion first and hypotheses after `of`, e.g. `normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsPretransitiveOfNormal_of_isRegular` or namespace it under `IsRegular` as `IsRegular.normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsPretransitiveOfNormal`.
findings.issue: `regularNormalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsPretransitiveOfNormal` prefixes the theorem with `regular`, but regularity is the explicit hypothesis `(hreg : IsRegular p)`, not part of the conclusion's subject.

summary: One new declaration puts a hypothesis word before the subject instead of after `of`, so the name does not read conclusion-outward in Mathlib style.
